title: When Does Superposition Emerge During Training? A Replayable Toy Study

original_idea.body:
# When Does Superposition Emerge During Training? A Replayable Toy Study

**Problem:** Toy Models of Superposition shows a phase change; whether superposition appears early or only later remains open.

**Direction:** Reproduce the Anthropic toy model, instrument feature geometry across training, vary sparsity and feature-to-dimension ratio to chart when each feature enters superposition.

**Why it matters:** Foundation for predicting which dangerous features get packed into shared directions. Toy model trainable in 30h.

**Relevant context:** Elhage et al. (transformer-circuits.pub 2022); UK AISI.
